title: Service-outage refunds
issue: After a service outage the support team refunds part of what affected customers paid. Add `outage_refund(payment, amount, at)` to `ledgerly/adjustments.py`: it refunds `amount` of a captured payment, adding it to `payment.refunded_amount` and setting the status to `"refunded"` once everything has been refunded. Return the payment. The amount must be positive, the total refunded may not exceed the captured amount, and only captured payments can be refunded.
